datasets.title: The single-cell atlas of the murine intrauterine tissues during preterm labor
datasets.summary: scRNA-seq was utilized to reveal that preterm labor affects the cellularity of the uterus, decidua, and cervix through immune cell infiltration and altered transcriptomic profiles of non-immune cell types.
datasets.overall_design: We utilized scRNA-sequencing coupled with an allogeneic murine model of intra-amniotic infection (using E. coli) to investigate the cellular landscape and cell-cell communications in the reproductive tissues (uterus, decidua, and cervix) during the process of preterm labor. In summary: C57BL/6 dams impregnated by BALB/c males were intra-amniotically injected with E. coli (n = 4) or PBS control  (n = 4) under ultrasound guidance, and the cervix, uterus, and decidua were collected 24 hours post-injection to prepare single-cell suspensions. Next, single cells were encapsulated in droplets using 10x Genomics technology and cDNA libraries were generated for sequencing.

datasets.title: Single-cell RNA-Seq of premature Rhesus macaques lungs with intra-uterine inflammation and therapuetic blockade
datasets._c56cdd: 索臻生物科技SOGEN·生信+湿实验一站式·一区顶刊课题合作·加群获取增量·微信bioinformaticsboy
datasets.summary: Intrauterine inflammation/infection (IUI), which is present in up to 40% of premature births, leads to elevated levels of pro-inflammatory mediators and microbial products within the amniotic fluid, which come in close contact to fetal mucosae. Yet, knowledge on the fetal mucosal responses to IUI exposure remains limited. To address these questions, we used a non-human primate model of IUI, in which pregnant Rhesus macaques received intra-amniotic (IA) LPS, compared with saline IA.  We found that IA LPS exposure induced a robust and rapid inflammation of the fetal lung.
datasets.overall_design: Single-cell RNA-Seq was performed in the premature Rhesus macaques lung in the presence and absence of LPS. Therapuetic intervention was tested in LPS animals with IL-1R, TNF-alpha or combination blockade.
datasets.study_design: 恒河猴宫内LPS炎症早产胎肺scRNA-seq，比较IL-1RA、抗TNF及联合阻断效果
datasets.relevance_reason: 使用宫内LPS诱导的恒河猴早产模型模拟绒毛膜羊膜炎

evidence.relevant: 宫内炎症LPS模型是绒毛膜羊膜炎的经典动物模型，测序样本为直接暴露于炎症的胎儿肺，研究其炎症效应。
evidence.sequencing_type: 单细胞悬液制备(gentleMACS解离→过滤→红细胞裂解)，10x平台Cell Ranger处理，生成h5矩阵，明确单细胞分辨率
evidence.survival_analysis: 非人类患者样本，且无生存时间/状态字段
evidence.treatment: 阻断剂(TNF-α/IL-1R)处理组 vs LPS模型组和Saline对照，治疗干预为核心比较轴之一。
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: Saline为vehicle操作对照，属诱导模型伪健康对照，非独立真健康
evidence.correlation: 动物模型样本不计入，且样本数仅13，不满足患者>15要求
evidence.sample_source: 所有GSM均为胎肺组织，解离成单细胞悬液后直接测序，未分选特定细胞类型且未体外培养，属组织直接测序。
evidence.treatment_type: Anakinra为IL-1受体拮抗剂，Adalimumab为抗TNF单抗，均靶向特定细胞因子/受体，属靶向治疗。
evidence.pre_post_treatment: GSM仅含不同处理组（Saline、LPS、TNF-blockade等），无同一队列治疗前后时间点字段。

datasets.title: Granulysin-high decidual NK cells in macaques and humans share signatures of immune defense and regulation
datasets.summary: Decidual NK cells (dNK) are key immune effector cells at the maternal-fetal interface. dNK utilize the anti-microbial peptide granulysin (GNLY) to kill pathogens, without killing trophoblast cells. Since rodents lack the GNLY gene, the in vivo biology of GNLY expression by dNK and their control of microbes is not well-understood. Here we defined dNK GNLY expression in placental membranes of Rhesus macaques and humans. GNLY-high dNK of both species shared conserved transcriptional and protein signatures of anti-microbial defense and immunoregulation. In addition, both human and rhesus GNLY-high dNK responded to inflammation and infection by increasing their cytotoxic, cytokine and inflammatory signatures. Thus high GNLY expression defines a unique dNK type with active roles in innate immune defense in humans and Rhesus macaques. Defining the regulatory networks of GNLY expression by dNK and their mechanism of infection control will open up therapeutic opportunities to enhance immunity and reduce infection-related pregnancy complications
